7.4.3 Wake up process
There are different possibilities to wake-up a LIN channel. Either the upper layer re-
quests a wake-up through the LinIf_Wakeup call or a bus wake-up is detected. If
a bus wake-up is detected, LinIf_Wakeup is also called when the upper layer en-
ters the FULL_COM mode after a successful validation through the function LinIf_
CheckWakeup.
